question: Why did the live CD return DevInstallW error 259 for the RTL8139 and then load the driver after the models section gained the hardware ID?
allowedInputs: dll/win32/setupapi/driver.c IndexOneInf calls SetupDiGetActualSectionToInstallW on the manufacturer section, and BuildCompatListFromInfIndex returns success without scanning other INF files when that section has no hardware ID
drivers/network/dd/rtl8139/netrtl.inf already listed PCI\VEN_10EC&DEV_8139 and PCI\VEN_10EC&DEV_8138 under RealtekMfg
output/live-presence-boot.log DriverEntry returned 0x00000000 for rtl8139.sys, and ipconfig then showed 10.0.2.15
Reported: the previous live CD serial log, overwritten when QEMU reopened that file, showed DevInstallW error 259 for PCI\VEN_10EC&DEV_8139 before this INF change
